level: segment comparison from injected entry checkpoints (conditional on the entry state)

emulator.name: dosbox-automation
emulator.config: bridge default; the game is started with the argument GC (CGA adapter, BIOS mode 6)

recipe: bridge_stop / bridge_start, drive_mount C: -> .local/dosrun (a fresh DOSBox for boot-time functions)

segments.name: cga-init
segments.what: CGA driver init: mode 4 set-up, font/page tables, B800 cleared

segments.name: cga-hwinit
segments.what: hardware init incl. the CGA dither/ground tables (branch 030a)

exclusions.why: CS:c34c timer slot 8 callback: DOSBox ran the MT-32 tick (cbfc), the port the speaker tick
CS:c354 timer phase step set by the sound device install
MT-32 descriptor and queue pointers (device not selected in the port)
speaker driver voice count and voices (device state)
joystick calibration: DOSBox emulates a joystick, the port reports none (out of scope)

segments.name: cga-ground
segments.what: CGA ground fill, first race frame

comparison.memory: 0..A0000 minus raceReplayExclusions and the per-segment exclusions above
